main_measure.name: t-stat of mean of (forecast/10 x forward 24-bar excess return over window mean) on non-overlapping 24-bar blocks
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2, reject if t <= -2, inconclusive otherwise or if fewer than 100 active (forecast < 0) blocks

supporting_check.name: share of active blocks with negative forward 24-bar excess return (vs 50%)

decided_by: The main-measure t-stat lies strictly between -2 and 2, which neither confirms nor rejects.
reading: Each window's mean 24-bar return is the mean of the forward 24-bar returns from every bar of that window; all grid blocks (including forecast 0, whose product is 0) enter the t-stat; the supporting check passes when the share exceeds 50%.
